Name: GridCells
Label: Cells across map
Description: Controls the number of grid cells across the normalized map.

Name: GridThickness
Label: Line thickness
Description: Controls the width of the solid part of each grid line.

Name: GridSoftness
Label: Line softness
Description: Controls how gently each grid line fades into the surrounding cells.

Name: GridRotation
Label: Rotation
Description: Rotates the entire grid around its center in degrees.

Name: GridInvert
Label: Invert
Description: Swaps the grid lines and the space between them.
